title: Chapter 199 Incomplete Report (Iv)
content:
Chapter 199 Incomplete Report (Iv)

The few people did not say anything. They all knew that they were in an absolute disadvantage in front of Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo saw the incomplete report he needed from afar.

[Obtained the incomplete report (IV), the side quest has been completed 35%. ]

Another animation appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

In the far suburbs of Xianhe Town.

A huge altar stood, and on the altar, a huge wild boar monster corpse with a length of more than 100 meters was entangled by countless death auras.

Not long after, the wild boar monster slowly opened its scarlet eyes, stood up, and its flesh quickly melted.

In the end, it turned directly into a skeleton pig. The skin on its body did not completely decay, but became riddled with holes. Through some holes, the bones inside could be seen.

And the eyes did not disappear, but turned into a mixture of black, gray and red eyeballs.

A loud howl shook the four fields!

The surrounding skeleton beasts and skeleton soldiers shook for a while, and then it looked in the direction of Xianhe Town and rushed out like an arrow.

All the skeleton soldiers followed closely and swarmed away.

The scene changed, and the fat guard of Xianhe Town could not sit still when he saw the vast skeletons.

"Have the soldiers sent out for help left?" A trace of panic appeared on his face.

"Master, it's too late. We are surrounded. We have sent 5 groups of soldiers for help, but none of them succeeded in breaking through."

The guard collapsed to the ground, his eyes dull and full of despair.

The scene ended, and Wang Shuo took a deep breath.

It seemed that the truth of the destruction of the huge Black Dragon City thousands of years ago was like a scroll, unfolding before his eyes.

He was silent for a long time.

After a long time, he came back to his senses.

Looking at the reactions of others, it seemed that they were not shocked.

Wang Shuo asked Ayub, and then he was sure that they should not be able to see this animation.

He looked at several items on the ground, including soul crystals, energy crystals, and a sign.
